tools.name: picqer_list_products
tools.description: List active products with name, product code, price, supplier and stock settings. Use search for a fuzzy match on name, code or barcode, or productcode for one exact product. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: picqer_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its prices, supplier and settings. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/products/{idproduct}.

tools.name: picqer_get_product_stock
tools.description: Get stock of one product per warehouse: stock, reserved, reserved by picklists or backorders, and free stock. Give idwarehouse to get the locations of one warehouse. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/products/{idproduct}/stock[/{idwarehouse}].

tools.name: picqer_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with status, customer, delivery address and warehouses. Filter by status, customer, warehouse, tag, order number or date. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/orders.

tools.name: picqer_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its products, delivery and invoice address, notes and tags. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/orders/{idorder}.

tools.name: picqer_pause_order
tools.description: Pause an order that has status processing, with a reason (for example a wrong address). Its open picklists are paused too. Reverse with picqer_resume_order. Picqer API: POST /api/v1/orders/{idorder}/pause.

tools.name: picqer_resume_order
tools.description: Resume a paused order: its status returns to processing and its picklists resume. Picqer API: POST /api/v1/orders/{idorder}/resume.

tools.name: picqer_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with name, contact name, email and address. Search matches name, contact name, email and customer id. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: picqer_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer with its addresses and tags. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/customers/{idcustomer}.

tools.name: picqer_list_picklists
tools.description: List picklists: the picking work per warehouse, with status, assigned user and products. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/picklists.

tools.name: picqer_list_purchaseorders
tools.description: List purchase orders to suppliers, with status (concept, purchased, received, cancelled), supplier and warehouse. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/purchaseorders.

tools.name: picqer_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their contact and ordering details. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/suppliers.

tools.name: picqer_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses of the account, with their ids. Use these ids in the other tools. Picqer API: GET /api/v1/warehouses.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: picqer_pause_order, picqer_list_customers · Private data: picqer_list_customers, picqer_list_suppliers · Public sink: picqer_pause_order, picqer_resume_order, picqer_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: picqer_pause_order, picqer_list_customers · Private data: picqer_list_customers, picqer_list_suppliers · Public sink: picqer_pause_order, picqer_resume_order, picqer_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
